messages:
alex_support: FYI customer JunoCorp reported an invoice jump this morning, ~130k tokens higher than what their SDK estimator showed. Invoice=1,290,432 tokens vs dashboard/SDK ~1,160,200. account=juno-prod-02, invoice_id=INV-2024-09-17

maria_billing: Is this the same org that had streaming reconnect alerts yesterday?

kevin_engineer: Looking into it — can you paste a minimal repro or the request they used (SDK vs raw API)?

alex_support: They sent a Node SDK snippet (using rwinference-sdk tokenEstimate). Customer says estimator returned ~14.2k for a session but our metering shows ~15.8k. They attached the request body, here's the gist:

alex_support: ```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  model: "redwood-analog-7b",
  messages: [
    { role: "system", content: "You are an assistant." },
    { role: "user", content: "Find top 5 docs about product usage" },
    { role: "tool", name: "search", content: "[tool request omitted]" }
  ],
  functions: [ { name: "search", ... } ],
  stream: false
}
```

ingrid_metering_bot: Metering note: our billing counts all tokens processed by the service including system messages, tool/function inputs and outputs, and any server-injected metadata. SDK estimator historically only counts user+assistant content unless explicitly configured to include system/functions.

josh_cust: we believed tool outputs (search results blob) were not billable — that's why we didn't include them in our local tally.

kevin_engineer: Two likely causes: (1) SDK estimator default excludes system/function tokens, (2) large tool outputs in function call responses count on the server. Also streaming reconnects can cause duplicates in rare cases, but no reconnects flagged for this session.

alex_support: I grabbed a real function response from their logs — payload has ~6.8k chars JSON with many doc excerpts. That will add a lot of tokens. snippet:

alex_support: ```
assistant: { role: "tool", name: "search", content: "[{\"title\":\"Doc A\",\"text\":\"Long excerpt...\"}, ...]" }
```

maria_billing: Policy check: billing includes any token transmitted through the inference path. Customer-facing wording needs to be clear that function/tool outputs are billable.

kevin_engineer: Quick repro on my machine with their sample: using SDK v0.8.2 tokenEstimate (default) -> 14200 tokens. If I set estimator option include_system_and_functions=true I get 15810 tokens which matches metering within margin. Example call I used:

kevin_engineer: ```js
const est = client.tokenEstimate({ messages, include_system_and_functions: true });
console.log(est.totalTokens); // 15810
```

ingrid_metering_bot: Confirmed: metering pipeline tokenized server-side after function expansion and server-side normalization. Any server-side expansions (e.g., retrieval results, tool post-processing) are counted.

alex_support: Customer wants credit/adjustment request. Recommended reply draft: we explain the difference, attach repro, offer guidance (switch SDK estimator flag or post-process to exclude tool payloads locally when estimating), and offer one-time invoice review if they provide sample session IDs. Thoughts?

maria_billing: +1. Offer a one-time invoice review and point to SDK config docs. Also create a small billing FAQ blurb.

kevin_engineer: Action items: (a) docs PR to clarify estimator defaults and add example with include_system_and_functions, (b) add a console warning in SDK when estimator excludes system/functions and large function outputs present, (c) offer customer instructions to set include_system_and_functions or to pre-count server-side tool outputs. I'll open tickets.

josh_cust: Thanks — appreciate the clear explanation. We'll repro with the flag and follow up. :thumbsup:

alex_support: I'll send the draft reply and open the invoice review request. Marking this as customer-facing follow-up.

kevin_engineer: I verified counts match when estimator is toggled. Closing engineering investigation; handing to billing/docs owners for next steps. :white_check_mark:
